table.name: TLGNC_PLANT_COMPCODE
table.description: A plant has to be assigned to exactly one company code. Several plants can be assigned to one company code.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. (Production) plant related to the Sales Areas. One Plant can be assigned to many Sales Areas.

column.name: COMPANYCODE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_companycode_bs. A company code as known in SAP (BUKRS), e.g.: FR01, BG01.
